profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at dutchie
profile.summary:
I'm a software engineer who loves to learn and solve complex challenges.

Technologies I frequently use and have proficiency in:
Front End | JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Redux
Back End | C#, SQL, Node.js

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer Resident
positions.description:
- Conducted technical interviews for incoming engineers, assessing their knowledge and fluency in JavaScript, object oriented programming, and test-driven development
- Reviewed and debugged the JavaScript, React, and Node.js code of over 50+ software engineering students
- Hosted community events and after hours talks for students within a remote learning environment

positions.title: E-commerce Intern
positions.description:
- Grew business development relationships with online business loan vendors for the small business loan team
- Improved First Midwest's online brand presence on LendingTree by coordinating with the call center team, management, and LendingTree vendors
